newsitem.title: FRANCE: French employer lobby says election clears outlook.
newsitem.headline: French employer lobby says election clears outlook.

text.p: French CNPF employers' lobby boss Jean Gandois said on Monday President Jacques Chirac's decision to call an early election would ensure a clearer outlook for companies and avoid paralysis of decision-making.
Gandois told reporters his employers' federation had been concerned that a long campaign period would have disrupted and slowed decisions.
Decisions to be made on Europe were of crucial importance and the government needed to have "maximum strength" to promote the interests of France, he said.
After the elections the government will have the means to carry out an ambitious policy, he said.
"The coming decisions on Europe will be crucial and the government has to have maximum strength to promote France's interests," Gandois said.
"We had been worried that during a long pre-electoral period, all decisions would have been delayed or slowed down."
